dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Alex is bonded to his sister Marley and they make quite the dynamic duo. They enjoy play wrestling and relaxing together for very funny and entertaining viewing. Alex can be a bit more independent and likes to go on his own mini adventures. His true joys are during playtime as he loves to show off his jumps and acrobatic skills. Extra high jumps if he gets the chance to play on the couch or bed! Outside of play, Alex likes his peace and quiet and curling up for favorite naps. He gives you your space during the day to get work done, but might come by and lie down near your feet just to do a quick check-in. Alex is not necessarily one for cuddles and brushes, instead he bonds with you through fun and games. He should be going to a home that is a bit more quiet as both him and Marley prefer slow introductions to new people and surroundings. Once he does however, Alex makes for a great cat buddy who is always down for some fun.
dog.name: Alex
